selection_policy: Purposive analytical sample, not representative of all managers or a performance ranking. Verifiable legal identity; >=8 distinct 13F quarters, or documented reporting-parent continuity; one independent reporting group; two requested quarters must be traceable. Notice entities retained outside the denominator. Mixed equity styles and structures; exclude trading/market-making books and unresolved related reporting groups. Membership fixed before comparing movements.
